correctness.rationale: For reduced u_n/v_n=(x_0+...+x_n)/h, the next pair is (u_n²+v_n²,u_nv_n) and remains coprime. With g=gcd(h,u_n), Q_{n+1}=(u_n+2v_n)/g=(u_{n-1}+v_{n-1})²/g for n≥1. An odd prime dividing g precludes integrality by coprimality; if g has no odd prime and is even, it equals 2 since a sum of two odd squares is 2 mod 8. Division by 2 then precludes an integer square. This independently establishes the imported criterion. Over F_p, 0 maps to infinity and infinity is fixed. For p≡3 mod 4 zero has no preimage; for p≡13,17 mod 20 the two roots of -1 have no preimages since the discriminant -5 is a nonsquare; over F_2 the sole preimage 1 has no preimage. Thus an incident prime can affect Q_2 only. Matching the valuations of x_0 and h at an active p reduces the obstruction to one or two residue classes modulo p^{a+1}, and the CRT yields the stated counts, including 167·287=47929 at h=221. For least period, the nonempty no-failure set is a product of nonempty local good sets; any period must preserve each local set and its complement under translation. A nontrivial translation modulo p^{a+1} has orbit lengths divisible by p, incompatible with 0<r_p<p. Hence each active modulus divides a period; the empty product gives period one. The supplied verifier was inspected, not executed; the finite-field loop tests active primes rather than all eligible inert primes, which are handled analytically.
